other_conditions: Any minor who is a Citizen of India is eligible to open an account under the scheme up to the age of eighteen years.
The account must be opened by a natural or legal guardian in the minor’s name.
The guardian must comply with KYC norms as per PFRDA requirements.
If the guardian is court‑appointed, a copy of the court order confirming guardianship must be submitted.
benefits_summary: Provides a head start on retirement savings for children, with automatic transition to a regular NPS Tier‑I account at age 18.
documents_required: Proof of Date of Birth of the minor
KYC details of the guardian (Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Address, Photo) fetched from UIDAI or CERSAI database
Court order confirming guardianship (if guardian is court‑appointed)
